scope: GL-specific fixed Tusass and Government of Greenland/NunaGIS assignment, Polygon, rights, empty-geometry and no-proxy evidence plus shared application contracts. No raw source body, address, person/customer/postal-box/property/cadastral/land-right data, production polygon, real GL AGID API response or browser area was promoted.

checks.command: run-local deterministic Node byte/SHA-256, 32-feature/31-code and empty-geometry validation
JSON.parse changed JSON; node --check changed JavaScript; git diff --check

applicationVerification.browserE2e: not run because no rights-cleared immutable GL artifact is eligible for the AGID API/app path
applicationVerification.separateDataApp: not built because the existing application path is the required surface and a separate report app would not resolve the rights blocker

knownLimitations: The official live Polygon response is technically usable but not eligible for AGID redistribution/public serving under the reviewed terms.
The source publishes no fixed release/reference date and includes empty 2412 and 3992 Polygon features.
No municipality, locality, place-name, address, building, route, Point, buffer, hull, cell, model or synthetic fixture was promoted.
environmentNotes: Dependencies were restored from the existing npm cache into the isolated worktree with npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts; no network dependency retrieval or install script ran.
